nodes.name: agent_trader.py
nodes.summary: CLI and runtime authority layer for analytics scans, CIO-authorized paper entries and management, background guardians, legacy autonomous loop, and end-of-day safety actions.

nodes.name: AIAgentTrader
nodes.summary: Combines live feeds and analytics into a legacy rule-driven trading cycle that can manage existing positions and, in its automatic path, open a paper trade.

nodes.name: _TeeStream
nodes.summary: Mirrors guardian and autonomous-loop console output to the persistent agent log.

nodes.name: square_off_all_positions
nodes.summary: Closes all tracked paper positions at live marks for the mandatory end-of-day cash rule.

nodes.name: inspect_the_generals
nodes.summary: Reports weighted macro alignment from the major index constituents.

nodes.name: scan_sector_heatmap
nodes.summary: Produces a sector-strength view for selecting possible discretionary candidates.

nodes.name: scan_fo_universe
nodes.summary: Scans the F&O universe for liquid tradable candidates and setup evidence.

nodes.name: scan_machine_radar
nodes.summary: Ranks symbols with machine-level market-structure telemetry for CIO review.

nodes.name: scan_super_setups
nodes.summary: Aggregates technical and option evidence into a ranked setup display without requiring it to be acted upon.

nodes.name: scan_quant_physics
nodes.summary: Displays quantitative flow, volatility, and option-physics diagnostics for a candidate.

nodes.name: run_autonomous_loop
nodes.summary: Legacy background loop that scans the universe and can autonomously open or manage paper trades from deterministic signals.

nodes.name: cio_enter_trade
nodes.summary: Executes an external CIO's explicit paper-entry decision after checking thesis, clock, live quote, spread, collision, ban, capacity, cash, and risk constraints.

nodes.name: cio_manage_trade
nodes.summary: Applies an external CIO's explicit trailing-stop, partial-booking, or exit decision to an open paper position.

nodes.name: run_guardian_loop
nodes.summary: Refreshes the cockpit and performs only emergency stop-loss or 15:15 IST exits; it intentionally does not open or discretionarily manage trades.

nodes.name: print_session_status
nodes.summary: Reports live and legacy ledger status, open positions, and daily paper-trading performance.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses CLI commands and routes them to cockpit, CIO, guardian, logic-test, legacy autonomous, and reporting workflows.

nodes.name: greeks_gex.py
nodes.summary: Calculates option Greeks, gamma exposure, pinning and squeeze regimes that inform but do not authorize trade decisions.

nodes.name: OptionGreeks
nodes.summary: Structured option-Greeks result used by frontier analytics.

nodes.name: FrontierAnalysisResult
nodes.summary: Structured gamma-landscape and volatility-regime result used by the cockpit.

nodes.name: FrontierAnalyticsEngine
nodes.summary: Evaluates Black-Scholes Greeks and option-chain gamma exposure to classify pinning or short-gamma regimes.

nodes.name: mcp_server.py
nodes.summary: MCP tool surface exposing analytics, the cockpit, portfolio state, and paper-trading actions to an external agent.

nodes.name: analyze_options
nodes.summary: Returns option-wall, PCR, and recommendation analytics for a requested symbol.

nodes.name: get_gex_and_greeks
nodes.summary: Returns gamma-exposure and Greeks analysis to the external CIO agent.

nodes.name: check_generals_alignment
nodes.summary: Exposes major-constituent directional alignment as discretionary market context.

nodes.name: scan_fo_breakouts
nodes.summary: Exposes F&O breakout candidates for external review.

nodes.name: get_sector_heatmap
nodes.summary: Exposes sector leadership and rotation context.

nodes.name: get_market_lens_breadth
nodes.summary: Exposes market breadth and related lens metrics.

nodes.name: evaluate_super_setup
nodes.summary: Builds composite setup evidence for a symbol without making the final trade decision.

nodes.name: execute_paper_order
nodes.summary: Legacy direct paper-order tool that writes to the ledger without the full CIO thesis and live-market safety gate.

nodes.name: close_paper_order
nodes.summary: Closes a paper position at a supplied exit price and records realized friction and P&L.

nodes.name: get_portfolio_summary
nodes.summary: Returns the aggregate paper-ledger performance summary.

nodes.name: get_open_positions
nodes.summary: Returns current open paper positions for CIO management.

nodes.name: get_cockpit_briefing
nodes.summary: Builds and returns the compact multi-signal CIO briefing.

nodes.name: cio_authorize_entry
nodes.summary: MCP entry point for an external CIO's explicit entry decision, delegating to the gated CIO authorization function.

nodes.name: cio_manage_position
nodes.summary: MCP entry point for an external CIO's trail, partial-book, and exit decisions.

nodes.name: run_regime_logic_test
nodes.summary: Runs historical regime validation as evidence for the CIO rather than as an execution trigger.

nodes.name: options_analytics.py
nodes.summary: Nuvama-style option-chain analytics for OI walls, PCR, max pain, buildup classification, and trade-context recommendations.

nodes.name: OptionStrikeData
nodes.summary: Structured per-strike option-chain data model.

nodes.name: NuvamaAnalyticsResult
nodes.summary: Structured result containing walls, PCR, max pain, confidence, and analytical thesis.

nodes.name: NuvamaOptionsEngine
nodes.summary: Computes Nuvama-style OI and price analytics from option-chain data.
